title: In illo témpore: Sublevátis Iesus óculis in cælum

editorial.notes: John 17:1–11, ending within verse 11 at et ego ad te venio; Gospel heading and cross-sign are source framing, not body words.

source.method: Direct transcription from the identified Benziger printing, compared in full with the retained Vatican typical-edition reproduction; two accidental differences are recorded. No abbreviated ending is expanded.
